    • 字段详细资料

      • dataRedundancyType

        @NameInMap(value="DataRedundancyType")
public String dataRedundancyType

        The redundancy mode of the file system.

        Valid values:

        • LRS: locally redundant storage. This is the default value.
        • ZRS: zone-redundant storage. If you select ZRS, ZoneId must be a string that consists of multiple zone IDs for zone-redundant storage, such as zoneId1,zoneId2.
        example:

        LRS

      • dedicatedClusterId

        @NameInMap(value="DedicatedClusterId")
public String dedicatedClusterId

        The ID of the dedicated cluster for Apsara File Storage for HDFS.

        example:

        alidfs-DC-f76f7ca5-*****

      • description

        @NameInMap(value="Description")
public String description

        The description of the file system.

        The description can be up to 32 characters in length.

        example:

        This is the first Apsara File Storage for HDFS instance for our company

      • fileSystemName

        @NameInMap(value="FileSystemName")
public String fileSystemName

        The name of the file system. The name must meet the following requirements:

        • The name must be 6 to 64 characters in length.
        • The name must be globally unique and cannot be an empty string.
        • The name can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        MyFirstHDFS

      • inputRegionId

        @NameInMap(value="InputRegionId")
public String inputRegionId

        The region ID.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        cn-hangzhou

      • meteringMode

        @NameInMap(value="MeteringMode")
public String meteringMode

        The metering mode.

        example:

        UsageBased,CapacityBased

      • partitionNumber

        @NameInMap(value="PartitionNumber")
public Integer partitionNumber

        This parameter is reserved and does not require configuration.

        example:

        0

      • protocolType

        @NameInMap(value="ProtocolType")
public String protocolType

        The protocol type.

        Only Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) is supported.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        HDFS

      • provisionedThroughputInMiBps

        @NameInMap(value="ProvisionedThroughputInMiBps")
public Long provisionedThroughputInMiBps

        The provisioned throughput. This parameter is required when ThroughputMode is set to Provisioned.

        Unit: MB/s.

        Valid values: 1 to 5120.

        example:

        1024

      • spaceCapacity

        @NameInMap(value="SpaceCapacity")
public Long spaceCapacity

        The capacity of the file system.

        You cannot write data when the amount of stored data reaches the file system capacity.

        Unit: GiB.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        1024

      • storageSetName

        @NameInMap(value="StorageSetName")
public String storageSetName

        This parameter is reserved and does not require configuration.

        example:

        AligroupStorageSet

      • storageType

        @NameInMap(value="StorageType")
public String storageType

        The storage medium type.

        Valid values:

        • STANDARD: standard storage. This is the default value.
        • PERFORMANCE: performance storage.

        This parameter is required.

        example:

        STANDARD

      • throughputMode

        @NameInMap(value="ThroughputMode")
public String throughputMode

        The throughput mode.

        Valid values:

        • Standard: standard throughput. This is the default value.
        • Provisioned: provisioned throughput.
        example:

        Standard

      • zoneId

        @NameInMap(value="ZoneId")
public String zoneId

        The zone ID.

        example:

        cn-hangzhou-b
